(def sort
  "Returns a sorted sequence of the items in coll. Comp can be
   boolean-valued comparison function, or a -/0/+ valued comparator.
   Comp defaults to compare."
  (fn
    ([coll] (sort compare coll))
    ([comp coll]
     (if (seq coll)
       (let [a (if (suss.bootstrap/object-array? coll) coll (to-array coll))
             n (alength a)
             scratch (suss.bootstrap/packed-array 6 n)
             runs (suss.bootstrap/packed-array 6 128)
             cmp (fn [x y]
                   (let [r (comp x y)]
                     (if (suss.bootstrap/boolean? r)
                       (if r -1 (if (comp y x) 1 0))
                       (suss.bootstrap/int-value r))))]
         ;; Original adaptive stable merge sort. Natural runs retain numeric
         ;; comparison staging; binary insertion preserves equal-element order.
         ;; A bounded run stack merges adjacent runs with balanced lengths.
         (letfn [(reverse-run! [lo hi]
                   (loop [i lo j (cljs.core/dec hi)]
                     (if (cljs.core/< i j)
                       (let [x (aget a i)]
                         (aset a i (aget a j)) (aset a j x)
                         (recur (cljs.core/inc i) (cljs.core/dec j)))
                       nil)))
                 (count-run! [lo hi]
                   (let [second (cljs.core/inc lo)]
                     (if (cljs.core/>= second hi)
                       1
                       (let [descending (cljs.core/< (cmp (aget a second) (aget a lo)) 0)
                             end (loop [i (cljs.core/inc second)]
                                   (if (cljs.core/< i hi)
                                     (let [c (cmp (aget a i) (aget a (cljs.core/dec i)))]
                                       (if (if descending (cljs.core/< c 0) (cljs.core/>= c 0))
                                         (recur (cljs.core/inc i)) i))
                                     i))]
                         (if descending (reverse-run! lo end) nil)
                         (cljs.core/- end lo)))))
                 (binary-sort! [lo hi start]
                   (loop [i start]
                     (if (cljs.core/< i hi)
                       (let [pivot (aget a i)
                             at (loop [left lo right i]
                                  (if (cljs.core/< left right)
                                    (let [mid (cljs.core/bit-shift-right (cljs.core/+ left right) 1)]
                                      (if (cljs.core/< (cmp pivot (aget a mid)) 0)
                                        (recur left mid) (recur (cljs.core/inc mid) right)))
                                    left))]
                         (loop [k i]
                           (if (cljs.core/> k at)
                             (do (aset a k (aget a (cljs.core/dec k)))
                                 (recur (cljs.core/dec k)))
                             nil))
                         (aset a at pivot)
                         (recur (cljs.core/inc i)))
                       nil)))
                 (run-base [i] (aget runs (cljs.core/* i 2)))
                 (run-length [i] (aget runs (cljs.core/inc (cljs.core/* i 2))))
                 (merge-at! [size at]
                   (let [lo (run-base at)
                         mid (run-base (cljs.core/inc at))
                         hi (cljs.core/+ mid (run-length (cljs.core/inc at)))
                         length (cljs.core/+ (run-length at) (run-length (cljs.core/inc at)))]
                     (loop [i lo j mid k lo]
                       (if (cljs.core/< k hi)
                         (if (or (cljs.core/>= j hi)
                                 (and (cljs.core/< i mid)
                                      (cljs.core/>= (cmp (aget a j) (aget a i)) 0)))
                           (do (aset scratch k (aget a i))
                               (recur (cljs.core/inc i) j (cljs.core/inc k)))
                           (do (aset scratch k (aget a j))
                               (recur i (cljs.core/inc j) (cljs.core/inc k))))
                         nil))
                     (loop [i lo]
                       (if (cljs.core/< i hi)
                         (do (aset a i (aget scratch i)) (recur (cljs.core/inc i))) nil))
                     (aset runs (cljs.core/inc (cljs.core/* at 2)) length)
                     (loop [i (cljs.core/inc at)]
                       (if (cljs.core/< i (cljs.core/dec size))
                         (do (aset runs (cljs.core/* i 2) (run-base (cljs.core/inc i)))
                             (aset runs (cljs.core/inc (cljs.core/* i 2)) (run-length (cljs.core/inc i)))
                             (recur (cljs.core/inc i)))
                         nil))
                     (cljs.core/dec size)))
                 (collapse! [count]
                   (loop [size count]
                     (if (cljs.core/> size 1)
                       (let [at (cljs.core/- size 2)]
                         (cond
                           (or (and (cljs.core/> at 0)
                                    (cljs.core/<= (run-length (cljs.core/dec at))
                                                 (cljs.core/+ (run-length at) (run-length (cljs.core/inc at)))))
                               (and (cljs.core/> at 1)
                                    (cljs.core/<= (run-length (cljs.core/- at 2))
                                                 (cljs.core/+ (run-length (cljs.core/dec at)) (run-length at)))))
                           (let [at (if (cljs.core/< (run-length (cljs.core/dec at))
                                                    (run-length (cljs.core/inc at)))
                                      (cljs.core/dec at) at)]
                             (recur (merge-at! size at)))
                           (cljs.core/<= (run-length at) (run-length (cljs.core/inc at)))
                           (recur (merge-at! size at))
                           :else size))
                       size)))
                 (finish! [count]
                   (loop [size count]
                     (if (cljs.core/> size 1)
                       (let [at (cljs.core/- size 2)
                             at (if (and (cljs.core/> at 0)
                                         (cljs.core/< (run-length (cljs.core/dec at))
                                                      (run-length (cljs.core/inc at))))
                                  (cljs.core/dec at) at)]
                         (recur (merge-at! size at)))
                       nil)))]
           (if (cljs.core/< n 32)
             (let [run (count-run! 0 n)] (binary-sort! 0 n run))
             (let [minimum (loop [work n carry 0]
                             (if (cljs.core/>= work 32)
                               (recur (cljs.core/bit-shift-right work 1)
                                      (cljs.core/bit-or carry (cljs.core/bit-and work 1)))
                               (cljs.core/+ work carry)))]
               (loop [lo 0 size 0]
                 (if (cljs.core/< lo n)
                   (let [run (count-run! lo n)
                         remaining (cljs.core/- n lo)
                         forced (if (cljs.core/< remaining minimum) remaining minimum)
                         length (if (cljs.core/< run forced)
                                  (do (binary-sort! lo (cljs.core/+ lo forced) (cljs.core/+ lo run)) forced)
                                  run)]
                     (aset runs (cljs.core/* size 2) lo)
                     (aset runs (cljs.core/inc (cljs.core/* size 2)) length)
                     (recur (cljs.core/+ lo length) (collapse! (cljs.core/inc size))))
                   (finish! size))))))
         (with-meta (seq a) (meta coll)))
       ()))))
